hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.

scenes.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

hero_props.name: Yonah’s five barley loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: Yonah’s small lunch, first carried in a bundle, then given to Andrew and Jesus. It changes form through the miracle: the loaves and fish are multiplied, distributed, eaten, and gathered as leftovers.
hero_props.reason: This is the central miracle prop and thematic object: a small gift placed in Jesus’s hands becomes enough for everyone. It appears, is discussed, and is transferred repeatedly.

hero_props.name: three honey-date cakes wrapped in cloth
hero_props.description: Miri’s three honey-date cakes, kept in a cloth bundle. They begin as something she guards for herself and end as food she shares with Tav and Nim.
hero_props.reason: They drive Miri’s lesson about generosity, recur across the home-world scenes, and are finally given away.

hero_props.description: The baskets used to hold, distribute, and gather the multiplied loaves and fish, culminating in twelve full baskets of leftovers.
hero_props.reason: The baskets are central visual proof of abundance, pass through many hands, and are repeatedly handled during distribution and gathering.

hero_props.name: small scroll of the five loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: The magical story scroll Saba draws down, sealed with a loaf-and-two-fish mark; opening it brings Miri and Nim into the feeding of the crowd.
hero_props.reason: It is the focused object that opens the story-world lesson and reappears afterward as the physical vessel of that story.

hero_props.name: Tav’s broken toy cart
hero_props.description: Tav’s toy cart with a loose wheel; it appears broken when Miri first refuses him and is later repaired with Miri and Nim’s help.
hero_props.reason: The cart recurs as Tav’s tangible need and gives Miri another way to open her hands after sharing the cakes.
